events.headline: Baseten releases mammoth-1 and elephant-1, open-weight decision models compatible with the System One interface.
events.label: Official announcement
events.note: MIT-licensed 27B and 9B weights, bundled serving files, and a technical report are public. Benchmark ranks are dated vendor claims; report and model cards differ on image-training provenance.
events.date_note: Official announcement visibly dated October 21; October 19 model repository creation is not used as the public release date.

attention.note: Observable model-page interest and launch discussion, not a claim of viral popularity. Included for a documented two-model open-weight release and accompanying methods report.

events.headline: Cloudflare previews Clairic, extending Jev-inspired System One models to typed extraction and estimation.
events.label: Official announcement
events.note: Available as a hosted Workers AI preview. Open weights are planned, not a verified release; model outputs still require task-specific evaluation.

events.headline: OpenRouter launches Armor beta, using Jev to screen agent tool calls against policy.
events.label: Official documentation
events.note: Hosted integration with natural-language rules and Claude Code-compatible auto permissions through Ori. [Launch post](https://x.com/OpenRouter/status/2110838205654470840); beta behavior and classifier errors remain relevant.

attention.note: Two separately hosted reports inspected. This records observable coverage, not X engagement counts; the X endpoints were unavailable.

events.date_note: October 15 launch date from the official post embedded in GIGAZINE, corroborated by AI Primer; documentation confirms the beta.

events.headline: TypeSafe releases Jev 1.14 preview with experimental images, Box localization, and longer context.
events.label: Official announcement
events.note: Opt-in features are not presented as production-ready. Images also work with Jev 1.13; Box requires 1.14. The announcement schedules the jev-latest alias change for a week later.

events.headline: TypeSafe announces an $870M Series A at a $7.5B valuation, led by a16z.
events.label: Official announcement
events.note: Financing and company plans; no new Jev model version is announced.

events.headline: Microsoft launches Microsoft-Decision-1; Vercel adds TypeSafe-compatible access.
events.label: Microsoft announcement
events.note: Independent hosted decision model; performance claims are vendor-reported. [Vercel integration](https://vercel.com/changelog/microsoft-decision-1-now-available-on-ai-gateway).

events.headline: Cloudflare releases Clef-omni for typed decisions over text, images, audio, and video.
events.label: Cloudflare announcement
events.note: Apache-2.0 weights and inference code are public. The same announcement updates Clef serving and lowers the hosted Flash price and context limit without replacing its weights.

events.headline: Cloudflare releases Clef and Clef-flash, open-weight multimodal decision models with Jev-compatible interfaces.
events.label: Announcement
events.note: [Clef](https://huggingface.co/Cloudflare/clef) and [Clef-flash](https://huggingface.co/Cloudflare/clef-flash) weights and inference code are available. Launch discussion: [626 points / 217 comments on Hacker News](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49923692), observed 2026-10-04.

events.headline: JevSpawn proposes adaptive agentic inference with compositional action spaces.
events.label: Paper

events.headline: AutoTrust releases JEV-27B-VL, an independent open-weight model for typed decisions over text and images.
events.label: Announcement
events.note: [Apache-2.0 weights](https://huggingface.co/autotrust/JEV-27B-VL) and serving code are public. The author announcement has 165 Hugging Face upvotes, observed 2026-10-08. This is the September 30 release, added retrospectively.

events.headline: Chinese-Jev introduces Chinese-language decision training and CJ-Bench.
events.label: Paper
events.note: Weights remain pending in the checked repository.

events.headline: A broad Jev evaluation examines 37 datasets, calibration, and answer formats.
events.label: Paper

events.headline: JevOut investigates how natural-looking context can redirect typed decisions.
events.label: Paper

events.headline: Visual Jev explores efficient decisions over shared visual context.
events.label: Paper

events.headline: Jev-Mem introduces a System One controller for agent memory.
events.label: Paper

events.headline: Laya 0.1.0 is published on PyPI, an early runtime release in the open decision-model ecosystem.
events.label: Release
events.note: This dates the Python package, not the model checkpoints.

events.headline: Vercel adds Jev to AI Gateway.
events.label: Announcement

events.headline: TypeSafe AI introduces Jev and System One models.
events.label: Original announcement
